intro.heading: Explore Our Academic Degrees
intro.text: Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST) is offering a wide range of undergraduate and graduate programs designed to prepare students for the challenges of the modern world.

programs.name: B.Sc. Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
B.Sc. Engineering in Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE)
B.Sc. Engineering in Industrial and Production Engineering (IPE)
B.Sc. Engineering in Information and Communication Technology (ICT)

admission_overview.heading: Admission Overview
admission_overview.lead: The admission process at BAUST is highly competitive and merit-based.
admission_overview.capacity_text: Each department currently accepts only 100 students* in each semester to maintain the highest quality of education and personalized attention.
admission_overview.footnote: *3 percent of the total seats are reserved for children of Freedom Fighters, and another 3 percent for meritorious candidates from remote and underdeveloped areas.

apply_cta.heading: Ready to Apply?
apply_cta.text: Start your journey with BAUST today by filling out our online form.
